records.source: Stir Fry/Stir Fry! It's a perfect way to get some healthy greens on your plate. Sautee the greens in a little sesame oil and make sure to add plenty of fresh ginger and garlic. Now breathe deeply... Oh, that's good.
records.translation: Ginisang Gulay/Ginisang Gulay! Perpektong paraan ito upang magkaroon ng masustansiyang berdeng gulay sa plato mo. Igisa ang mga gulay sa kaunting langis ng linga at tiyaking magdagdag ng maraming sariwang luya at bawang. Ngayon, huminga nang malalim... Ah, ang bango.

records.source: Coleslaw/Coleslaw! Envisioning bland mounds of limp cabbage? You're not alone. But a great coleslaw can be so much more. Make sure you have juicy fresh cabbage for this one. Toss with a little vinegar and mayonnaise and you're all set. Ah, that's crisp.
records.translation: Ensaladang Repolyo/Ensaladang Repolyo! Naiisip mo ba ang matabang bunton ng lantang repolyo? Hindi ka nag-iisa. Pero higit pa roon ang isang mahusay na ensaladang repolyo. Tiyaking sariwa at makatas ang repolyo mo para rito. Haluin sa kaunting suka at mayonesa at handa na. Ah, napakalutong.

records.source: Radish Salad/Radish Salad! There's nothing like a fresh, peppery radish. It reminds me of the late spring... my mother would slice up our fresh radishes and serve them on grainy bread with a little salt and pepper. Ah, those were the days... but I digress. Now, watch closely...
records.translation: Ensaladang Labanos/Ensaladang Labanos! Walang tatalo sa sariwa at maanghang na labanos. Ipinapaalala nito sa akin ang huling bahagi ng tagsibol... Hinihiwa ni Mama ang sariwa naming labanos at inihahain sa tinapay na may buo-buong butil, na may kaunting asin at paminta. Ah, kay sarap ng mga araw na iyon... pero lumilihis na ako. Ngayon, tingnang mabuti...

records.source: Omelet/Omelet! This is such a simple dish, but so often done incorrectly! A perfect omelet is a thing of beauty. It's a pure golden angel of gleaming egg, and I'm going to show you my secret method...
records.translation: Omelet/Omelet! Napakasimple ng pagkaing ito, pero napakadalas gawin nang mali! Kay gandang pagmasdan ang perpektong omelet. Isa itong dalisay at ginintuang anghel ng kumikislap na itlog, at ipapakita ko sa iyo ang lihim kong paraan...

records.source: Baked Fish/Baked Fish! Whenever I make this one at home, my two cats go bananas. I need a second chef around just to keep them from hopping on the counter for a bite! Just make sure the fish is fresh, preferably caught with your own rod! Now watch as I place the fish on a bed of spring greens...
records.translation: Isdang Inihurno/Isdang Inihurno! Tuwing ginagawa ko ito sa bahay, nababaliw ang dalawa kong pusa. Kailangan ko ng isa pang kusinero para lang pigilan silang tumalon sa mesada at kumagat! Tiyakin lang na sariwa ang isda, mas mabuti kung nahuli gamit ang sarili mong pamingwit! Ngayon, panoorin habang inilalagay ko ang isda sa sapin ng mga gulay na pang-tagsibol...

records.source: Pancakes/Pancakes! Sometimes I get carried away with fancy, complicated dishes... but there's something comforting about a simple pancake. You'll want plenty of butter and maple syrup to slather over these warm stacks... mmmm....
records.translation: Mga Pancake/Mga Pancake! Kung minsan ay nadadala ako sa magagara at masalimuot na pagkain... pero may nakaaaliw sa simpleng pancake. Kakailanganin mo ng maraming mantikilya at arnibal ng maple upang ipahid sa maiinit na bunton ng pancake... mmmm....

records.source: Maki Roll/Maki Roll! The delicate flavor of the ocean, sealed within a pillowy cloud of rice. Maybe a bit of wasabi for the adventurous. My mouth is watering as we speak. Oh, how I love sushi...
records.translation: Maki Roll/Maki Roll! Ang banayad na lasa ng karagatan na binalot sa malambot na ulap ng kanin. Baka kaunting wasabi para sa mahilig sa pakikipagsapalaran. Naglalaway na ako habang sinasabi ko ito. Ah, gustong-gusto ko ang sushi...

records.source: Bread/Bread! Breadmaking can be a very complex form of art, but I'll make it simple for you. The most important ingredient is flour, of course. But before we create the dough we'll need to activate our yeast. They prefer warm water and a little something to feed on. I use plain sugar, but honey or maple syrup will do!
records.translation: Tinapay/Tinapay! Maaaring napakamasalimuot na sining ang paggawa ng tinapay, pero pasisimplehin ko ito para sa iyo. Siyempre, harina ang pinakamahalagang sangkap. Pero bago tayo gumawa ng masa, kailangan nating buhayin ang pampaalsa. Gusto nito ng maligamgam na tubig at kaunting makakain. Karaniwang asukal ang gamit ko, pero maaari rin ang pulot o arnibal ng maple!

records.source: Tortilla/Tortillas! How many of you are gnawing on a microwaved convenience-burrito while watching this program? Shame on you! You might as well wrap your beans in an old wash rag. Now, listen up. Once you've tried my fresh, rustic corn tortillas you'll never go back...
records.translation: Tortilla/Mga Tortilla! Ilan sa inyo ang ngumangatngat ng madaling ihanda at minikroweyb na burrito habang pinapanood ang programang ito? Mahiya kayo! Para na rin ninyong binalot ang mga balatong sa lumang basahan. Ngayon, makinig kayo. Kapag natikman ninyo ang sariwa at payak kong tortilla ng mais, hindi na kayo babalik sa dati...

records.source: Trout Soup/Trout Soup! There's something about fresh-caught trout that just gets me buzzing. Maybe it's the subtle taste of the river. At any rate, I've got a wonderful trout soup recipe to share with you today...
records.translation: Sabaw na Trutsa/Sabaw na Trutsa! May kung ano sa bagong-huling trutsa na talagang nagpapasigla sa akin. Marahil ang banayad na lasa ng ilog. Anuman iyon, may napakagandang resipe ako ng sabaw na trutsa na ibabahagi sa iyo ngayon...

records.source: Glazed Yams/Glazed Yams! It's yam season, and what better way to enjoy these delightful tubers than by slathering them in a sweet, sticky glaze? You'll need a nice, ripe yam and a whole bunch of sugar. Now, here's how you do it...
records.translation: Minatamis na Kamote/Minatamis na Kamote! Panahon ng kamote, at may mas mabuti pa bang paraan upang tamasahin ang kaaya-ayang lamang-ugat na ito kaysa balutin ng matamis at malagkit na pampakintab? Kakailanganin mo ng maganda at hinog na kamote at napakaraming asukal. Ngayon, ganito ang gagawin...

records.source: Artichoke Dip/Artichoke Dip! This is a delightful way to get more artichokes into your body. Personally, I don't even dip anything in there. I just guzzle the sauce down like it's a milkshake. Delicious.
records.translation: Sawsawang Artichoke/Sawsawang Artichoke! Kaaya-ayang paraan ito upang makapagpasok ng mas maraming artichoke sa katawan mo. Ako mismo, wala man lang akong isinasawsaw dito. Nilalagok ko lang ang sarsa na parang milkshake. Napakasarap.

records.source: Plum Pudding/Plum Pudding! Little Jack Horner is champing at the bit for this ooey-gooey delight. And who can blame him? The plums are floral and sweet, with just the right amount of tartness to fully activate every last one of your eager taste buds. You'll just have to try it and see for yourself...
records.translation: Puding na Plum/Puding na Plum! Sabik na sabik si Munting Jack Horner sa malapot at malagkit na pagkaing ito. At sino ang masisisi sa kaniya? Mabulaklak at matamis ang mga plum, na may tamang asim upang buhayin ang bawat sabik mong panlasa. Kailangan mo lang itong tikman upang malaman...

records.source: Chocolate Cake/Chocolate Cake! What better way to spend these cold winter nights than digging your way through a rich chocolate mountain? With my help, you'll be well on your way to creating the finest cake you've ever laid eyes on. Now, you're going to need a lot of sugar...
records.translation: Keyk na Tsokolate/Keyk na Tsokolate! May mas mabuti pa bang paraan upang palipasin ang malamig na gabi ng taglamig kaysa ubusin ang isang masaganang bundok ng tsokolate? Sa tulong ko, makagagawa ka na ng pinakamagandang keyk na nakita mo. Ngayon, kakailanganin mo ng napakaraming asukal...

records.source: Pumpkin Pie/Pumpkin Pie! In my house, it's a tradition to eat pumpkin pie during the Feast of the Winter Star. The season just isn't complete without that wonderful flavor you can only achieve with the finest farm-fresh pumpkins. A little nutmeg, cinnamon, and clove will sweep you off to a land of crimson and gold...
records.translation: Pai ng Kalabasa/Pai ng Kalabasa! Tradisyon sa bahay namin ang kumain ng pai ng kalabasa tuwing Piging ng Bituin ng Taglamig. Hindi buo ang panahon kung wala ang kahanga-hangang lasang makukuha lamang sa pinakamainam at bagong aning mga kalabasa mula sa bukid. Dadalhin ka ng kaunting moskada, kanela, at klabo sa lupain ng matingkad na pula at ginto...

records.source: Cranberry Candy/Cranberry Candy! Here's a fun one to help you celebrate the new year. Cranberries are quite bitter on their own, but submerge them in an ocean of sugar and they'll taste like angel's tears. Here's how you do it...
records.translation: Kendi na Cranberry/Kendi na Cranberry! Narito ang isang masayang paraan upang ipagdiwang ang bagong taon. Mapait ang mga cranberry kapag walang halo, pero ilubog ito sa dagat ng asukal at lalasa itong parang luha ng anghel. Ganito ang gagawin...
